### Should fix before opening

**F1 · P2 · architecture/conventions**: `apps/web/src/features/feature-flags/store/index.ts:1`
- **What:** The new `features/feature-flags/` folder holds only a `store/` folder. It has no `contract.ts`, `feature.ts`, top-level `index.ts` or feature flag.
- **Why:** `apps/web/AGENTS.md:8-9` and `docs/feature-architecture.md:306,920` say every feature must export a contract and sit behind a feature flag. Folders like `gtf/` have the full structure.
- **Fix:** Either give it the full feature structure, or, since this is state used by a developer tool, move the slice to `apps/web/src/store/featureFlagOverridesSlice.ts` next to the other slices of its kind.

**F2 · P2 · security**: `apps/web/src/store/index.ts:95` (and `:67`)
- **What:** The overrides are added to `persistedSlices`. That means every user in every environment has them saved to `localStorage`, shared between tabs, and loaded back on startup with no validation (`persistStore.ts` `getPreloadedState`).
- **Why:** Nothing reads the overrides yet, so this is harmless today. But once a consumer such as `useHasFeature` honours them, anything in `localStorage` will override real chain feature flags in production, and a leftover dev override will stick around silently.
- **Fix:** Before a consumer lands, only save and read the overrides in non-production builds (or behind an explicit dev gate). Also check keys against `FEATURES` when loading them.

### Worth a ticket or a quick follow-up

| ID | Priority | Where | What |
|---|---|---|---|
| F3 | P3 · bugs | `featureFlagOverridesSlice.ts:29-32` | Saved keys for a `FEATURES` value that is later removed or renamed are never cleaned up. `selectOverrideCount` still counts them, and the typed `clearOverride` can't remove them. Filter to `Object.values(FEATURES)` when counting or loading. |
| F4 | P3 · KISS | `featureFlagOverridesSlice.ts:24` | `setOverride`, `clearOverride`, `clearAllOverrides` and both selectors are never used outside the slice and its test. This is dead code at merge unless a stacked PR uses it, so say which one in the PR description. |
| F5 | P3 · testing | `featureFlagOverridesSlice.test.ts:30-34` | The only change that touches the rest of the store is adding the slice to the saved-state list, and nothing tests that. Also, "clears a single override" starts from a single key, so it can't catch a `clearOverride` that wipes everything. Start that test with two keys and assert one remains, and add a load-from-storage case in `store/__tests__/index.test.ts`. |

### Your call

| ID | Options |
|---|---|
| F1 | full feature structure · move to `src/store/` · keep and note why in the PR |
| F2 | gate it now · gate it in the PR that adds the consumer (say so in the PR) |
| F3–F5 | fix · ticket · skip |

### Considered and dropped
- **`{} as RootState` / `as unknown as RootState` in tests:** the repo does this in 15 other files, so it isn't a convention break.
- **Lost deletes when saved state is loaded back:** loading happens once, on mount (`useHydrateStore.ts`). Tabs share changes by replaying actions, so a deleted key can't come back.

### Not checked
- I didn't run type-check, lint, prettier or tests (you asked me not to).
- Findings weren't checked by the paired agents, which is why there's no score.
- No "since your last run" comparison, and no cleanup proposals. The diff is 88 lines, and the only cleanups worth making are the findings above.
